description: In-universe dynamic news feed and faction drama bulletins for Project Nova

articles.headline: EDF ORDERS MANDATORY CORE SURRENDER AT HELIOS GATE
articles.teaser: Military checkpoints establish total embargo on civilian fusion battery movement.
articles.body: HELIOS REACH — Earth Defense Fleet Command has cordoned off the Helios Warp Corridor, boarding all incoming private freighters and impounding class-three thermal containment units. Vice Admiral Sterling cited 'unprecedented solar degradation and extreme military operational necessity'.

articles.headline: BLACK MARKET HEAT CORE AUCTION SPARKS CANTINA STANDOFF
articles.teaser: Weapons drawn in Station Nova-1 lower promenade over salvage from the 'Meridian'.
articles.body: STATION NOVA-1 — Tensions flared in the lower cantina concourse last night as an unflagged smuggler attempted to auction a high-yield fusion core with scrubbed serial numbers. Eyewitnesses report drawing of weapons before station security intervened.

choices.label: Buy & Donate Core to Station Life Support

articles.headline: DERELICT ALIEN MEGASHIP ACTIVATES IN FORBIDDEN NEBULA
articles.teaser: Ancient automaton swarm vessels emit high-frequency green resonance.
articles.body: THE PERIMETER — Deep range sensor arrays have detected massive energy surges inside the Azure Nebular Veil. Long-dormant automaton ships—pejoratively nicknamed 'Clankers'—have begun radiating coherent emerald-spectrum energy.

articles.headline: STRANDED HABITAT FLOTILLA BROADCASTS SOS IN SUB-ZERO VOID
articles.teaser: Twelve hundred refugees face life support freezeout following engine cascade failure.
articles.body: OUTER DRIFT — A makeshift flotilla of seven converted mining freighters carrying twelve hundred civilians from the abandoned lunar colony 'Cold Harbor' has experienced total engine failure. Cabin temperatures are plummeting toward zero.
